output.subject: We've received your message about your mortgage payoff and escrow refund
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us, and congratulations on the sale of your home. We have received your message, and we want to confirm the main points as you described them.

You told us you paid off your mortgage on 8/5 when the house sold. You mentioned that you believe the payoff quote included a monthly payment that had already been drafted, and you estimate this resulted in an overpayment of $2,244.18. You also told us you expect an escrow refund of about $896.50, and that you have not yet received either amount. You asked for a status update, and you let us know you would like both amounts sent by ACH to your credit union account.

A specialist team is reviewing your message and will respond within 10 business days. Thank you for the clear details you provided and for your patience. We're sorry for any inconvenience while you wait to hear back from us.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm whether the 8/5 payoff quote included a monthly payment that had already been drafted, and the resulting overpayment amount (customer states $2,244.18).
Confirm the remaining escrow balance at payoff (customer estimates about $896.50).
Check whether any overpayment or escrow refund has already been issued or mailed, and to what address.
Customer asked for ACH to a credit union account and included bank details in the email; decide whether ACH is an option and verify any banking details through an approved channel before acting.
Customer framed this as a polite status request; the reply should give a concrete status update once the specialist team has reviewed it.
